title: Aster Index closed-world authoring
description: Tests whether an author can turn an inspected, closed source packet into concise encyclopedic prose without allowing a minor host relationship to displace the subject.

article.title: Aster Index
article.article_object: A concise encyclopedia article about the archive, its holdings, catalogue method, and documented limits.
article.reader_need: Explain what the archive contains, who maintains it, how it is organized, and what limits its coverage.
